semiconductor_relevance: High — New Power Plasma Co., Ltd. specializes in RF generators and plasma power systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: New Power Plasma Co., Ltd. is a leader in the development of RF generators, matching networks, and remote plasma cleaning generators, providing critical power control and stability for semiconductor fabrication processes. The company focuses on R&D to meet the evolving needs of the semiconductor market, aiming to enhance its global competitiveness.
capabilities: RF Generators for plasma power supply

regional_presence.Korea: The company is recognized as one of Korea's top technology firms, contributing to the localization of advanced semiconductor equipment.
